metadata.title: Storage Lifecycle & Retention Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines how storage platforms enforce the governed lifespan of data, including retention, legal holds, controlled replication, and secure deletion, independent of applications, automation, or operational convenience.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability responsible for defining and enforcing how long institutional information assets are retained and when they may be disposed.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability responsible for ensuring data retention, preservation, and destruction meet legal, regulatory, and contractual obligations.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Persistent storage platforms responsible for holding and deleting data according to governed lifecycle rules.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Technologies providing archival, records management, and long-term data preservation capabilities.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes platform storage services whose data lifecycle is governed by authoritative retention and disposal rules rather than application logic.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Institutional records subject to retention schedules and controlled disposal.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Data subject to legal, regulatory, or contractual retention and deletion requirements.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Data whose lifecycle is tied to institutional, legal, or compliance obligations.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines data-centric lifecycle governance, including retention enforcement, preservation obligations, and controlled destruction of data independent of consuming systems.

components.title: Retention Enforcement
components.description: Prevents premature deletion or expiration of data before the minimum governed retention period has elapsed.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Attackers and insiders may attempt early deletion to erase impact or evidence.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Data destruction exploits short or unenforced retention.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Enforces minimum retention independent of operational or user intent.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data is retained according to defined retention requirements.
Retention supports system availability and investigative needs.

components.title: Legal and Regulatory Holds
components.description: Allows authorized suspension of deletion and overwrite actions to preserve data required for legal, regulatory, or investigative purposes.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Adversaries may attempt to eliminate data subject to investigation or review.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Indicator and data removal undermines accountability.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Preserves data under authoritative legal or regulatory hold conditions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Evidentiary data is preserved to support investigations.
Legal and regulatory requirements are integrated into data lifecycle controls.

components.title: Replication and Residency Governance
components.description: Controls where data may be replicated and prevents unauthorized cross-boundary propagation.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Replication channels can mask large-scale data exfiltration.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Unauthorized data transfer abuses replication pathways.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Constrains and governs approved data movement and residency.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Logical and geographic boundaries are enforced on data flows.
Third-party and offshore storage risks are governed.

components.title: Secure and Verifiable Deletion
components.description: Ensures data destruction occurs only when authorized and is irreversible, auditable, and non-repudiable.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Malicious or premature deletion undermines governance and accountability.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Uncontrolled deletion disrupts operations and investigations.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Performs deliberate, governed, and auditable data destruction.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data is securely sanitized upon authorized disposal.
Deletion actions are non-repudiable and auditable.
